query: What are the six human needs?
why_in_two_sentences: Tony Robbins' own site answers the definitional query with the originator's authority but stays promotional and thin, and Transformation Institute is a short list-plus-free-test page. Ours explains the model more analytically than either: the need-versus-vehicle distinction, the dominant two, which needs pull against each other, and why a costly problem can be meeting a need, with 32 FAQs including whether the model is scientific.
what_we_do_that_they_dont: Separates the need (inborn, fixed) from the vehicle (learned, changeable), the distinction that makes the model usable
Explains why four needs usually get met and two often do not, and which needs pull against each other
Explains why anyone would hold on to a problem costing them everything: it is meeting a need
Covers Maslow, love-languages, and personality-type differentials plus the is-it-scientific question honestly
32 verbatim FAQs including the 7- and 10-needs variants searchers also ask

above_the_fold.ours: H1 is the query, the short answer lists all six needs in the first sentence and states the need-vehicle distinction, then recognition sentences; the definitional answer arrives immediately.
above_the_fold.theirs: Robbins' page opens with promotional blocks and rhetorical questions before defining anything; the brand carries it, the content does not.

trust_signals: Robbins is the framework's originator (unmatched provenance for this query) and Transformation Institute offers a free test; ours discusses the model more rigorously but names no source for it, not even Robbins.
one_change_with_most_traffic_impact: Publish an actual self-scoring dominant-needs quiz on the page; two of the top results offer a free test, our FAQ only discusses one, and an interactive tool is the strongest traffic and link asset available for this query.
